svg.text: delegates all five methods, adds none
a leak: it is not on the interface. Demo-only.
the seam — swap in a mock or a hardware-backed impl ✓
placeOrder returns an Order carrying its own status;
an out-of-stock brew is a FAILED order, not an exception
no getOrder(id) / cancel / refund on the interface
refill has no bounds check on `amount` (negatives allowed)
five methods is the whole public surface — good size for LLD
THE CORE — context for the State pattern
menu: Map<BeverageType, Beverage> — HashMap, built once
synchronized setState(newState) — called BY the states
brewOrder(beverage) — the real work, called by IdleState
doProcessPayment(id, p) — amount ≥ price, that is all
both public mutators are synchronized on the machine ⇒ one
order at a time, no interleaved brews ✓
brewOrder DISPENSES BEFORE PAYMENT. placeOrder brews and
consumes ingredients; processPayment is a separate later call
that never marks the order paid. Real machines take money first.
menu is a plain HashMap, but it is written only in the ctor and
never mutated after — effectively immutable, so safe to share.
orders is a CHM because only its writes cross the lock.
THE STATE PATTERN — and its honest limits
GoF STATE — the machine is passed IN, so a state can call machine.setState(next) and drive the transition itself
stateless ⇒ one shared instance is correct ✓
steps 2-4 all run inside ONE synchronized call —
so no other thread can ever observe DISPENSING.
every method rejects. This class is a pure guard —
and today it is UNREACHABLE from outside the lock.
It earns its keep the moment brewing goes async
(a real pump takes ~20s and must not hold a lock).
THE MODEL — recipe, inventory, order, payment
synchronized refill(ing, amt) — clamps to max
consume = check AND deduct in ONE lock ⇒ no TOCTOU ✓
a reader can catch a consume() mid-deduction.
recipe-as-data ⇒ new drinks add a map, not an if-else ✓
getRecipe() hands back the LIVE map — no defensive copy.
BeverageType also lists AMERICANO / MOCHA with no recipe.
Payment: id, orderId, amount: BigDecimal, method
OrderStatus.IN_PROGRESS is declared but never assigned
Payment.orderId is stored but never compared — a payment
for order A settles order B without complaint.
no PAID status, no change / refund, no receipt.

g.text: The classic bug: check stock, then
deduct it, with a gap between. Two
mutator anyway. The CHM is redundant:
a CHM makes single ops atomic, but
which only the lock gives you.
Pick one. A HashMap under the same
lock would be honest and cheaper.

svg.text: ① CoffeeMachine facade → CoffeeMachineService seam → ② CoffeeMachineImpl as the State context → ③ IdleState / DispensingState singletons → ④ model: recipe-as-data + the atomic IngredientContainer

g.text: Patterns: Facade · GoF State (singleton states) · recipe-as-data · atomic consume
Beverage vending — menu, brewing, inventory, payment — LLD
